posts.zh:
dsh-ds-attach 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。**DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标，从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7ff96179c1a9503aaffa.html
posts.en:
dsh-ds-attach is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7ff96179c1a9503aaffa.html
